title: Keep primary save backups local
changes: Keep automatic backups of the primary cartridge save beside that save; continue routing numbered debug-save backups to the configured private worktree.
When the primary save and local backups are missing, copy earlier private primary backups locally without deleting them or merging existing local histories.
validation: Linux synthetic tests passed: eight game-save, eight backup and three save-path tests; one optional backup test was ignored.
An isolated Linux X11 startup with synthetic saves confirmed local primary backup placement and private numbered-save backup routing after moving sibling folders.
limitations: Real game saves, a real desktop file chooser and native Windows were not exercised; the installed portable application was not replaced.
